name: Farmer
ability: When you die at night, an alive good player becomes a Farmer.
wakes: Does not wake. If the Farmer died tonight, an alive good player chosen by the Storyteller is woken late in the night.
interaction: Storyteller picks an alive good player and shows them YOU ARE and the Farmer token; their character becomes Farmer.
drunk_or_poisoned: If the Farmer is drunk or poisoned when they die at night, no new Farmer is made.

jinxes.text: Each night*, the Leviathan chooses an alive good player (different to previous nights): a chosen Farmer uses their ability but does not die.

rulings.text: Only good players can become the Farmer; evil Townsfolk/Outsiders are ineligible.
A Farmer turned evil (e.g. by Mezepheles) still creates a new Farmer when it dies at night.
Day deaths (e.g. execution) do not trigger the ability.
The new Farmer loses their old ability and its ongoing effects end immediately; Farmers do not learn who the other Farmers are.
Wording: roles.json says 'If you die at night'; the wiki page says 'When you die at night'. The wiki wording was used.
Night order numbers from bra1n/townsquare develop src/roles.json (firstNight/otherNight; 0 mapped to null).

test_scenarios.expected: Seat 5 is woken and learns they are the Farmer; seat 5 becomes Farmer and loses the Empath ability.

test_scenarios.name: evil ineligible
test_scenarios.setup: 5 players: 1 Farmer, 2 Imp, 3 Poisoner, 4 Chef, 5 Empath (dead).
